summary: Carter County, MO 100-foot lookout tower that CCC crews had put up by February 1935, per a newspaper quoted on the Central US Lookouts page; now recorded as removed.

facts.status_note: Recorded as removed; no source says what remains at the site.

events.note: Daily American Republic report of 2 February 1935 says the Ellsinore CCC crew had erected a 100-foot lookout tower; the report gives no build date, so 1935 is the report year, not the build year
Central US Lookouts record marks the tower as removed; no date given

evidence.supports: lookout tower in Carter County, listed under Mark Twain National Forest at 27N-3E-33
evidence.quote: Missouri Lookouts - Carter County - Mark Twain National Forest - 27N-3E-33

evidence.supports: newspaper report dated February 2, 1935 (Daily American Republic)
the Ellsinore CCC crew erected a 100-foot lookout tower (height_m 30.5)
evidence.quote: The Ellsinore boys have erected a100 foot lookout tower

evidence.supports: Joseph Blake was superintendent of the Ellsinore CCC camp
evidence.quote: Joseph Blake, superintendent of the Ellsinore CCC Camp

evidence.supports: Blake said all actual Forest Service work was done by the CCC crews
evidence.quote: All of the aqctual work of the Forest Service is done by the CCC boys

evidence.supports: Blake said the CCC organization might be temporary but its work permanent
evidence.quote: while the CCC organization may be temporary, the work it is doing is permanent

evidence.supports: the record marks the tower as removed

notes_for_editor: One source, the Central US Lookouts page, which quotes a Daily American Republic report of 2 February 1935 (not read directly). The quoted report does not name the tower's site, so linking the 100-foot tower to Ellsinore relies on the page's placement of the quote. Height 30.5 m comes from the 100-foot figure in that quote (the record already had it). The build date is not given; the event is recorded as other with the report year 1935. No removal date or post-removal status is documented. Wikipedia's Ellsinore article was checked and has nothing on the tower.
